title: Number of Subarrays Having Even Product
statement:
You are given an integer array `nums`. A subarray is a non-empty run of consecutive elements of `nums`.

Count how many subarrays have an even product, that is, how many runs multiply to an even number, and return that count.
notes:
## Intuition

A product is even as soon as one factor is even, so only the parity of each number matters. Checking every subarray is O(n²). Count by right end instead: a subarray ending at `i` is even exactly when it reaches back to some even element, which happens when it starts at or before the most recent even index `lastEven`. So there are `lastEven + 1` such subarrays ending at `i` (none if no even number has appeared yet, since `lastEven = -1`).

## Approach

1. Set `count = 0` and `lastEven = -1`.
2. For each index `i`, if `nums[i]` is even, set `lastEven = i`.
3. Add `lastEven + 1` to `count`: the starts `0..lastEven` give an even product with end `i`.
4. Return `count`.

## Example 1, step by step

`nums = [9,6,7,13]`. At `i = 0`, `9` is odd and `lastEven = -1`, so add `0`. At `i = 1`, `6` is even, `lastEven = 1`, add `2` (`[9,6]`, `[6]`). At `i = 2` and `i = 3` the numbers are odd, `lastEven` stays `1`, add `2` each time. Total `count = 6`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(n): one pass with constant work per element.
- Space: O(1): two variables.

## Pitfalls

- Do not multiply the numbers: the products overflow quickly, and only parity matters.
- The count can reach about n² / 2 ≈ 5 · 10^9, beyond 32-bit integers; use a 64-bit type in Java or C.
- Before the first even number nothing should be added, which `lastEven = -1` gives for free.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `count` | number of even-product subarrays found so far |
| `lastEven` | index of the latest even number seen, or `-1` |
| `i` | right end of the subarrays being counted |

narration.3: No even number seen yet, marked with -1.
narration.5: Treat each index as the right end of the subarrays we count.
narration.6: An even number makes every product that includes it even.
narration.7: Remember the most recent even position.
narration.9: Subarrays starting at 0..lastEven reach that even number, so lastEven + 1 of them end here with an even product.
narration.11: Every right end has been counted; return the total.
